## 🚨 Removed

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Terminology cleanup: Fix build time trend's distributed builds (#5625) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-66177](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66177) - Ability to disable Java 11 monitor (#5628) @amuniz
* [JENKINS-66139](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66139) - Avoid polluting the log if usage stats cannot be sent (#5621) @MRamonLeon

* Allow consumers of `XmlFile` to disable `fsync(2)` (#5599) @basil

* Bump spotless-maven-plugin from 2.12.1 to 2.12.2 (#5633) @dependabot

## :tada: Major features and improvements

* [JENKINS-60920](https://issues.jenkins-ci.org/browse/JENKINS-60920) - Revamp the layout and icons of the Jenkins header bar and breadcrumbs (#4463) @fqueiruga
* [JENKINS-60920](https://issues.jenkins-ci.org/browse/JENKINS-60920) - Introduce a new experimental UI that can be enabled by setting the jenkins.ui.refresh system property to true  (#4463) @fqueiruga
* [JEP-224](https://github.com/jenkinsci/jep/tree/master/jep/224), [JENKINS-12548](https://issues.jenkins-ci.org/browse/JENKINS-12548) - Add a new experimental `Overall/SystemRead` permission (#4506) @timja
* [JEP-223](https://github.com/jenkinsci/jep/tree/master/jep/223) - Add a new experimental `Overall/Manage` permission (#4506) @daniel-beck @EstherAF @mikecirioli @aHenryJard


## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JEP-223](https://github.com/jenkinsci/jep/tree/master/jep/223) - Deprecate dangerous `Overall/RunScripts`, `Overall/UploadPlugins`, and `Overall/ConfigureUpdateCenter` permissions (#4365) @mikecirioli
* Always set a crumb issuer (#4509) @daniel-beck
* Order Admin Monitors in Global Configuration page (#4487) @Dohbedoh
* Add memory usage monitor to system information page (#4499) @daniel-beck
* Improve performance when loading tied jobs (#4497) @res0nance
* Add french translation for concurrent build help (#4505) @jbleduigou

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

* [JENKINS-61121](https://issues.jenkins-ci.org/browse/JENKINS-61121) - Fix too many open files with resource domain (#4504) @daniel-beck

## :construction_worker: Changes for plugin developers

* Add new `checkAnyPermission`, `hasAnyPermission` methods that allow access if a user has one of the supplied permissions (#4506) @timja
* Add a new `f:possibleReadOnlyField` jelly tag, wraps fields in an if readonly check and then outputs the result as text if the authenticated user only has read access. N/A is added if the field is empty (#4506) @timja
* Developer: Add a new `l:hasAdministerOrManage` jelly tag, hides the body of the tag if the user doesn't have Jenkins.ADMINISTER or Jenkins.MANAGE (#4506) @timja

## 🚨 Removed

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Terminology cleanup: Fix build time trend's distributed builds (#5625) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-66177](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66177) - Ability to disable Java 11 monitor (#5628) @amuniz
* [JENKINS-66139](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66139) - Avoid polluting the log if usage stats cannot be sent (#5621) @MRamonLeon

* Allow consumers of `XmlFile` to disable `fsync(2)` (#5599) @basil

* Bump spotless-maven-plugin from 2.12.1 to 2.12.2 (#5633) @dependabot
